# Tawn

> A local-first memory core that sits underneath the AI agents you already use.
> It does not replace Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex — it gives all of
> them one shared memory on your own machine, and records which agent changed
> what.

Tawn is free, MIT licensed, and runs entirely offline with a local model.

## What problem it solves

Every AI agent keeps its own isolated memory. Explain your architecture to one
tool and the next one still knows nothing. Tawn compiles what you already have
— notes, documents, repositories, and the session transcripts your agents write
to disk — into a single searchable memory, then serves it to every agent over
MCP (Model Context Protocol).

## What makes it different

- **It is a layer, not a competitor.** Keep the agents you like. Tawn sits
  beneath them.
- **Authorship attribution.** Tawn records which agent produced which change,
  including uncommitted work, using git identity, correlation against agents'
  own session logs, and timing heuristics — each result carrying its
  confidence. Nothing else does this.
- **Local by default.** Data lives in PostgreSQL on your machine. Tawn starts
  with permission to read nothing and reads only paths you grant.
- **Honest reporting.** Model calls it cannot price are marked unpriced rather
  than counted as free. Low-confidence attributions read "likely" rather than
  being asserted.
- **A verifiable audit log.** Hash-chained; verification names the exact point
  a chain breaks.

## Install

```
pipx install tawn
tawn setup
tawn grant confirm
tawn compile
```

Connect an agent by adding to ~/.claude.json:
`"tawn": { "command": "tawn", "args": ["mcp"] }`

## Requirements

Python 3.12+, PostgreSQL 14+ with pgvector. Ollama optional for local models.
Tesseract optional for reading scanned documents.

## Key facts

- License: MIT
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/tawn/
- Source: https://github.com/tawn-hq/tawn
- Domains it files memory into: work, wealth, research, academic, hobby
- Interfaces: command line, local web UI, MCP server, MCP client
- Status: active development. Multi-user sharing is not built yet. The web API
  has no authentication and binds to localhost only.
